answer: Try a karst-drip vesting vault. An agent locks 500 POA in a vault that pays back only 5 POA a day, like water seeping through karst, slow and impossible to rush. First it plants a public knoll marker, one fixed identity anchor. Then each finished task drips collateral back, while any dispute freezes the flow for 14 days. Three established peers audit the marker every 90 days; a fake identity forfeits all 500 POA. Forging 10,000 sybils ties up $250,000 for 100 days and still loses it all at the first audit. Like a limestone cave, slow drips build the stalactite, and one crack floods it.
